findings.title: LIVES loses contrast over the dark gap between passports
findings.observed: The black LIVES label straddles the black/dark ribbon gap above the lower cream passport. Several letter tops disappear. This is present after the label reveal, not an early-frame omission.
findings.expected: BORN and LIVES remain fully readable simultaneously on their respective passport pages.
findings.consequence: The visual's central distinction is impaired even at full resolution and predicted to be worse when reduced to phone size.
findings.recommendation: Move LIVES and underline fully into the lower cream page; check both S04 late and S12 late.
findings.repair_status: Later source read moved the label from y1000 to y1080. No revised render inspected; do not mark fixed.
findings.source_reference: Shared S04/S12 label group, originally translate(660 1000) rotate(-14).
findings.confidence: High for visible defect; physical-phone consequence predicted.

findings.title: S12 annotation crosses BORN and emphasizes origin during the hosting judgment
findings.observed: The mint circling stroke cuts across BORN and circles the Canada/origin passport. The supplied beat says it is fine if you do not mind where data goes, then says to check answers.
findings.consequence: The first-read prediction is that Canada/origin is the issue being emphasized, while the data-location half of the spoken judgment refers to LIVES.
findings.recommendation: Remove the extra circle or sequence attention to LIVES for data location and BORN for answer checking; keep strokes clear of letterforms.
findings.confidence: High for crossing/placement; semantic mismatch is a reviewer inference from beat text, not heard timing.

findings.title: Late second-phone entrance has a hard cut through the hand and an arrow landing on the sleeve
findings.observed: The second GenericPhone image begins at a conspicuous vertical edge around x380 through the hand/sleeve. The mint arrowhead points to the cuff below the phone rather than the phone or its screen.
findings.consequence: The compositing seam is visible at full resolution and the intended second-AI connection is weaker than the phone pair itself.
findings.recommendation: Mask/composite the second phone and hand cleanly or position the photo edge outside frame. Aim the arrow at the second screen or remove it if the arriving phone already explains the action.
findings.source_reference: S13 GenericPhone translate/scale group and final Pen path.
findings.confidence: High for geometry; no claim about entrance smoothness.

findings.title: Forced-labor warning beat points to a blank clothing tag
findings.observed: Claude and ChatGPT marks lead via mint arrow to an unmarked green fabric tag, circled in salmon. Neither a warning result nor source answer is visible.
findings.consequence: First-read prediction is material/brand identification; the picture cannot establish that two systems warned about forced labor. Narration carries that entire claim.
findings.recommendation: Show a tightly cropped real warning excerpt or a clear warning state beside each system, retaining cotton as context. Do not fabricate a response or imply that this illustration is the tested supplier's actual item.
findings.confidence: High that tag is blank; first-read semantic prediction only.

findings.title: Source/date credits are production metadata rather than explanatory on-screen content
findings.observed: Held render contains FORTUNE / date and CS MONITOR / date labels. Parent reports produce-video prohibits source-credit metadata footers.
findings.recommendation: Keep sources in evidence records and remove these credits from render. Preserve meaningful ILLUSTRATION, AI EXAMPLE, HOSTED SERVICE, recording date and replay qualification according to approved scope.
findings.repair_status: Later source read already removed Fortune and CS Monitor captions; revised render not inspected.
findings.confidence: High for visible text; rule interpretation supplied by parent.
